latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of AfrexAI Spreadsheet Engineering skill — a comprehensive, platform-agnostic guide for building robust spreadsheets.

- Introduces a step-by-step methodology for spreadsheet architecture, formula patterns, and best practices, applicable to Google Sheets, Excel, and LibreOffice.
- Provides a quick health check for spreadsheet quality, with a scoring system out of 16.
- Details phased workflow: planning & requirements, sheet structure, naming conventions, color code standards, and formula engineering.
- Includes essential formula examples, lookup/aggregation patterns, dynamic arrays, and advanced formula techniques like LET and LAMBDA.
- Offers clear guidelines on when not to use spreadsheets and when to migrate to dedicated systems.
- Designed for creators of financial models, dashboards, and data systems seeking reliability and maintainability.
